subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on August 15th, 2022. Please find attached your e-ticket for reference. Make sure to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure for check-in. For any changes or inquiries, feel free to contact our customer service team. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Airline Team
